name: Praying Over Food
overview: Scripture teaches that praying over food is an act of honoring and recognizing God's provision and blessing. In both the Old and New Testaments, believers are instructed to bless the Lord for the sustenance He provides, as seen in Deuteronomy 8:10 and Exodus 23:25, where God promises to bless bread and water and remove sickness. Jesus exemplifies this practice by giving thanks and blessing bread before distributing it to His disciples and the multitude (Matthew 14:19; Matthew 26:26), emphasizing gratitude and dependence on God. Furthermore, Acts 27:35 records Paul giving thanks before eating, reinforcing the importance of acknowledging God's hand in daily nourishment.
